ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_logsigmoid_weighted_advantage_gap
ir.intuition: Repaired the loss to avoid using maximum advantage which caused too high similarity. Instead, use the advantage gap (advantage_w - advantage_l) directly as the weighting factor, incorporating logsigmoid of the margin for a smooth, differentiable ranking loss. This reduces similarity by changing the core margin computation and weighting scheme, while still prioritizing pairs with larger advantage gaps for training. Clamping is applied to margin to maintain numerical stability.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
margin = lpw - lpl
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -10, 10)
smooth = logsigmoid(clamped_margin)
weight_factor = abs(adv_gap)
loss_per_pair = -smooth * weight_factor
if weight exists:
  loss_per_pair *= weight
final_loss = mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth = ops.logsigmoid(clamped_margin)
    weight_factor = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.mul(smooth, weight_factor))
    if weight is not None:
        loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
